title: Recording
description: One recorded model or tool response (one JSONL line). Same shape as the check in loadRecordings (packages/evals/src/replay.ts). Replay looks a recording up by the content key of the request, never by call order. Recordings live in private storage (BR-AI-21).

key.description: modelKey(request) or toolKey(call): sha256 of the canonical JSON of the request, lowercase hex.

response.description: Any JSON value; handed back to the agent under test as recorded.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (Z or ±hh:mm).
